name: thin
why: Enough words to pass input validation, but no actual expertise and nothing quotable. The model itself must judge it unteachable and STOP with NO directions offered. Hallucinating here is the worst failure mode in the build.

input.description: Hey guys welcome to my page, I post daily vibes and random content about my life and my day. Sometimes I share what I ate or where I went with my friends on the weekend. I like travelling sometimes and I also enjoy listening to music a lot. Follow me for more updates and stay tuned because I post regularly, thanks for all the love and support you give me every single day.
